snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 094 - The Cameraman - Gekisha Boy Omakefu (2002)

DESCRIPTION
The Cameraman is an Action game, developed by Tomcat System and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2002.
